metadata.title: Earth Planetary Analog Locations
metadata.description: 50 scientifically curated Earth planetary analog field sites with real mean surface temperatures, target body specifications, primary testing foci, mineralogy, and historical rover/mission campaigns.

locations.name: Atacama Desert
locations.roversTested: NASA K-REX2 (ARADS), CMU Zoë, ESA ExoMars ExoFiT
locations.mineralogy: Perchlorate-rich evaporites, halite, nitrates & oxidizing regolith
locations.description: Hyper-arid nitrate and perchlorate desert floor serving as a premier Martian subsurface drilling and life-detection proving ground.

locations.name: McMurdo Dry Valleys
locations.roversTested: NASA Icebreaker Drill, NASA Ames Cryo-Astrobiology Campaigns, Phoenix Lander Calibration
locations.mineralogy: Dolerite, sandstone, hyper-saline permafrost & sulfate evaporites
locations.description: Antarctic polar desert valleys with ice-cemented permafrost and sublimation-dominated soils analogous to Martian high-latitude regolith.

locations.name: Mauna Kea
locations.roversTested: NASA RESOLVE / VIPER Prototypes, NASA ISRU Dust & Regolith Testbed, Apollo Geology Training
locations.mineralogy: Hawaiitic & basaltic tephra, palagonitic dust & vesicular scoria
locations.description: High-altitude basaltic tephra summit slopes used extensively to test lunar ISRU oxygen extraction, prospecting drills, and rover wheel traction.

locations.name: Icelandic Highlands
locations.roversTested: NASA RAVEN / SAND-E Campaigns, ESA PANGAEA-X, JPL ATHLETE & Field Robotics
locations.mineralogy: Tholeiitic basaltic sand, hyaloclastite glass & palagonite tuffs
locations.description: Barren glaciovolcanic basaltic sand plains and hyaloclastite ridges matching Martian fluvial-volcanic and lunar highland trafficability.

locations.name: Mojave Desert
locations.analogCategory: Rover Mobility, Slip Control & Desert Varnish Spectroscopy
locations.roversTested: NASA Curiosity Twin (Scarecrow), JPL Marsokhod, Mars 2020 Perseverance Mobility Tests
locations.mineralogy: Alluvial granitic gravel, desert pavement, clay playas & iron-manganese varnish
locations.description: Rugged desert washes, alluvial fans, and volcanic cinder cones used by JPL for full-scale Mars rover mobility and hazard-avoidance trials.

locations.name: Wadi Rum
locations.analogCategory: Sandstone Canyon Navigation & Human Habitat Simulation
locations.roversTested: OeWF AMADEE-18 Analog Mission, ESA ExoMars Field Trials
locations.mineralogy: Cambrian-Ordovician quartzose sandstone, ferric oxide dust & aeolian sand
locations.description: Iron-oxide-stained sandstone buttes and sandy wadis providing realistic canyon-navigation and EVA operations terrain.

locations.name: Namib Desert
locations.roversTested: ESA ExoMars Locomotion Testbed & Aeolian Wind-Tunnel Correlation
locations.mineralogy: Quartz-feldspar dune sand, magnetite grains & gypsum-cemented gravel
locations.description: Ancient hyper-arid dune seas and deflation gravel plains used to model Martian bedform migration and wheel sinkage.

locations.name: San Rafael Swell
locations.roversTested: NASA Mars Exploration Rover (MER) Field Training & MDRS Field Campaigns
locations.mineralogy: Gypsum-bearing Jurassic siltstones, red-bed sandstones & diagenetic concretions
locations.description: Exposed inverted river channels, gypsum-veined mudstones, and hematite concretions paralleling Meridiani Planum and Gale Crater.

locations.name: Ladakh Cold Desert
locations.analogCategory: High-Altitude Permafrost, Glacio-Lacustrine Clays & Habitat Ops
locations.roversTested: ISRO Spaceward Bound India, NASA-BSIP High-Altitude Astrobiology Expeditions
locations.mineralogy: Borate-rich hot-spring sinters, granite moraines & permafrost silts
locations.description: Cold high-altitude Himalayan desert featuring glacial moraines, permafrost soils, and hydrothermal borate springs.

locations.name: Yungay
locations.analogCategory: Ultra-Low Biomass Soils & Subsurface Life Detection
locations.roversTested: NASA ASTEP Life in the Atacama (CMU Zoë), NASA ARADS K-REX2, Viking Soil Benchmarks
locations.mineralogy: Anhydrite, halite, perchlorates & clay-poor oxidized silicate regolith
locations.description: The driest core of the Atacama Desert, providing a canonical terrestrial benchmark for Viking-era and modern Mars organic-detection instruments.

locations.name: Haughton Crater
locations.roversTested: NASA K10 Rovers & CMU Hyperion (Haughton-Mars Project), CSA Pressurized Rover Ops
locations.mineralogy: Polymict impact melt breccia, shocked Ordovician dolomite & ground ice
locations.description: 23-km Arctic impact structure preserving shocked target rocks, hydrothermal pipes, and continuous permafrost for lunar/Martian traverse trials.

locations.name: Lanzarote Volcanic Fields
locations.roversTested: ESA PANGAEA Astronaut Training, ESA CaveX & LUNA Analog Robotics
locations.mineralogy: Alkali olivine basalt, pyroclastic lapilli & intact lava tube basalt
locations.description: Fresh basaltic lava flows, spatter cones, and subterranean lava tubes used by ESA to train astronauts and subterranean scouting rovers.

locations.name: Svalbard
locations.analogCategory: Arctic Subsurface Drilling & Carbonate Globule Astrobiology
locations.roversTested: NASA AMASE (Arctic Mars Analog Svalbard Expedition), ESA ExoMars PanCam & WISDOM GPR
locations.mineralogy: Devonian red sandstones, basaltic complexes with carbonate globules & permafrost
locations.description: High-Arctic permafrost terrain containing Bockfjord carbonate globules petrologically analogous to Martian meteorite ALH84001.

locations.name: Salar de Uyuni
locations.analogCategory: Evaporite Crust Radar Sounding & Spectral Calibration
locations.roversTested: NASA/JPL LiDAR & Orbital Altimetry Calibration, High-Altiplano Astrobiology Campaigns
locations.mineralogy: Halite crusts, ulexite borates, gypsum & lithium-magnesium brines
locations.description: World's largest polygonal salt flat, utilized for orbital altimetry calibration and Martian chloride-basin evaporite modeling.

locations.name: Kīlauea Lava Fields
locations.roversTested: NASA Apollo Lunar Surface Training, NASA/HI-SEAS Basalt Traverses & FIDO Rover Tests
locations.mineralogy: Tholeiitic ʻaʻā and pāhoehoe basalt, Pele's tears volcanic glass & sulfur fumaroles
locations.description: Unweathered basaltic lava flows and tephra blankets directly comparable to lunar mare plains and Martian shield volcanism.

locations.name: Puna de Atacama
locations.roversTested: NASA Astrobiology High-Andean Lake Expeditions & Raman Spectrometer Field Trials
locations.mineralogy: Arsenic-rich evaporites, gypsum stromatolites, ignimbrites & basaltic andesite
locations.description: High-altitude volcanic plateau with hypersaline lakes and extreme UV flux modeling early Noachian Martian crater-lake shorelines.

locations.name: Río Tinto
locations.roversTested: NASA MARTE Drill & ESA Eurobot, ExoMars RLS Raman & Mössbauer Calibration
locations.mineralogy: Jarosite, hematite, goethite, schwertmannite & massive sulfide gossans
locations.description: Extreme low-pH iron-sulfate river system precipitating jarosite and hematite diagnostic of ancient acidic aqueous alteration on Mars.

locations.name: Death Valley
locations.analogCategory: Alluvial Fan Geomorphology & Salt-Crust Radar Penetration
locations.roversTested: NASA Mars Pathfinder Field Trials, JPL Marsokhod & Curiosity Mastcam Calibration
locations.mineralogy: Alluvial conglomerate fans, borax/halite evaporites & desert-varnished basalt
locations.description: Mars Hill boulder fields, Badwater evaporite pans, and Ubehebe Crater used to test landing-site rock-size distributions and rover cameras.

locations.name: Painted Desert
locations.analogCategory: Phyllosilicate Clay Stratigraphy & Orbital Spectral Correlation
locations.roversTested: USGS CRISM/OMEGA Phyllosilicate Ground-Truthing & Planetary Geology Field Schools
locations.mineralogy: Smectite-rich Chinle mudstones, hematite siltstones & cross-bedded sandstones
locations.description: Iron-stained smectite mudstone badlands closely matching orbital CRISM detections of phyllosilicate-bearing Martian paleolakes.

locations.name: Afar Depression
locations.analogCategory: Volcanic Rift Tectonics & Basaltic Salt Crusts
locations.roversTested: ESA/ASI Dallol-Erta Ale Planetary Volcanology & Extremophile Field Expeditions
locations.mineralogy: Flood basalts, rhyolitic ignimbrites, halite crusts & hydrothermal sulfur
locations.description: Active continental rift combining extensive basaltic lava fields with evaporitic salt plains analogous to Valles Marineris grabens.

locations.name: Dallol Geothermal Area
locations.roversTested: Europlanet / CNRS Polyextreme Astrobiology & Raman Spectroscopy Campaigns
locations.mineralogy: Hyper-acidic Fe-Mg-Cl brines, halite chimneys, jarosite & native sulfur
locations.description: Hyper-saline, hyper-acidic hydrothermal mound system defining terrestrial physicochemical boundaries for Martian astrobiology.

locations.name: Pāhoehoe Lava Fields, Hawaiʻi
locations.analogCategory: Smooth Basaltic Sheet Flows & Lunar Mare Morphology
locations.roversTested: NASA BASALT Research Program, Apollo 15-17 Geology Training
locations.mineralogy: Glassy ropy pāhoehoe basalt, plagioclase phenocrysts & vesicular crust
locations.description: Ropy inflated basaltic lava sheets used during NASA BASALT missions to refine science-driven human-robotic planetary traverses.

locations.name: La Guajira Desert
locations.roversTested: Regional Planetary Geomorphology & Aeolian Sediment Transport Surveys
locations.mineralogy: Quartzose dune sand, marine-marginal gypsum & carbonate hardgrounds
locations.description: Trade-wind driven desert dunes bordering evaporitic salt flats, useful for modeling wind-scour and bedform transitions.

locations.name: Rub' al Khali
locations.analogCategory: Mega-Dune Wheel Sinkage & Orbital Radar Bathymetry
locations.roversTested: NASA/JPL Shuttle Radar Imaging Studies & Regional Desert Robotics Trials
locations.mineralogy: Iron-oxide coated quartz sand, interdune sabkha evaporites & gypsum
locations.description: Vast hyper-arid erg with linear and star megadunes separated by flat evaporite sabkhas, paralleling Martian north-polar and equatorial ergs.

locations.name: White Sands
locations.analogCategory: Sulfate Dune Migration & In-Situ XRD Mineralogy
locations.roversTested: NASA CheMin / Curiosity Gypsum Calibration & Aeolian Lidar Field Campaigns
locations.mineralogy: Hydrous calcium sulfate (gypsum) sand & selenite evaporite playa crusts
locations.description: World's largest gypsum dune field, serving as the direct mineralogical analog for Olympia Undae's Martian gypsum dunes.

locations.name: Taklamakan Desert
locations.analogCategory: Star Dune Dynamics & Dust Storm Electrostatics
locations.roversTested: CNSA Tianwen-1 Aeolian Calibration & Arid Basin Remote Sensing Surveys
locations.mineralogy: Silicate-rich aeolian sand, loess silt & gypsum-halite desert crusts
locations.description: Endorheic hyper-arid Tarim Basin dune sea used to study regional dust-lifting cycles and complex dune morphology.

locations.name: Gobi Desert
locations.roversTested: Mars Society Field Operations & CNSA Zhurong Mobility Benchmark Studies
locations.mineralogy: Wind-faceted basaltic ventifacts, desert pavement & red Cretaceous sandstones
locations.description: Cold rocky desert pavement strewn with wind-abraded ventifacts closely resembling Mars Pathfinder and Gale Crater lag surfaces.

locations.name: Danakil Salt Flats
locations.roversTested: Europlanet Salt-Crust Astrobiology & Mössbauer/Raman Field Campaigns
locations.mineralogy: Carnallite, halite, sylvite, kainite & hydrothermal iron-oxide crusts
locations.description: Sub-sea-level evaporite basin preserving thick chloride-sulfate sequences shaped by volcanic heat and desiccation.

locations.name: Namib-Naukluft Gravel Plains
locations.analogCategory: Deflation Gravel Lag & Hyper-Arid Soil Microbiology
locations.roversTested: NASA/ESA Hyper-Arid Desert Varnish & Soil Moisture Sensor Calibration
locations.mineralogy: Calcrete-cemented gravel lag, quartz pebbles & gypsum-rich subsurface horizons
locations.description: Expansive wind-scoured gravel lag plains used to investigate soil-moisture hysteresis and desert-pavement stability.

locations.name: Oman Hajar Mountains
locations.roversTested: OeWF AMADEE-20 Analog Mission & Deep Serpentinite Astrobiology Drilling
locations.mineralogy: Samail ophiolite peridotite, serpentine, magnesite veins & travertine
locations.description: Exposed oceanic mantle ophiolite exhibiting active low-temperature serpentinization and carbonate veining akin to Jezero Crater's olivine-carbonate unit.

locations.name: Siccar Point / Scottish Coast
locations.roversTested: UK Centre for Astrobiology Field Training & ExoMars PanCam Geologic Context Studies
locations.mineralogy: Silurian greywacke, Devonian Old Red Sandstone & hematitic basal breccia
locations.description: Classic angular unconformity outcrop used to train planetary rover science teams on stratigraphic contact interpretation.

locations.name: Pilanesberg Volcanic Complex
locations.roversTested: Regional Impact-Volcanic Ring Structure & Remote Sensing Benchmark Surveys
locations.mineralogy: Nepheline syenite, foyaite, trachytic tuff & alkaline ring-dyke complexes
locations.description: Deeply eroded concentric ring-complex structure providing orbital morphology comparisons for ringed planetary calderas and craters.

locations.name: Mount Etna Lava Fields
locations.analogCategory: Autonomous Multi-Robot Sample Return & Volcanic Navigation
locations.roversTested: DLR ARCHES SpaceBot Campaign, ESA ROBEX & ROBUST Lunar/Martian Trials
locations.mineralogy: Alkali-basalt lava flows, trachybasaltic scoria & volcanic ash
locations.description: High-altitude basaltic ash and blocky lava slopes hosting European Space Agency and DLR multi-robot autonomous lunar/Martian demonstrations.

locations.name: Reykjanes Peninsula
locations.roversTested: NASA/USGS Fissure-Flow Radar Mapping & Icelandic Analog Rover Traverses
locations.mineralogy: Fresh olivine tholeiite basalt, volcanic glass & sulfur-clay alteration zones
locations.description: Fresh fissure-fed basaltic lava fields and graben fractures paralleling lunar sinuous rilles and Cerberus Fossae.

locations.name: Sierra Negra Volcano
locations.analogCategory: Shield Caldera Collapse & Basaltic Pit Crater Mapping
locations.roversTested: NASA/USGS Caldera Volcanology & Interferometric Radar Analog Studies
locations.mineralogy: Plagioclase-phyric tholeiitic basalt, sulfur-encrusted fumarole tuffs & tephra
locations.description: Broad basaltic shield caldera with nested pit craters analogous to Martian Tharsis shield volcanoes and lunar mare depressions.

locations.name: Pinnacles Desert
locations.roversTested: Australian Astrobiology Field Studies & Mars Analog Spectral Surveys
locations.mineralogy: Aeolianite calcarenite pillars, quartz sand & iron-stained karstic crusts
locations.description: Exhumed carbonate pillars protruding through quartz sand sheets, providing obstacle-field geometry for close-range rover hazard mapping.

locations.name: Simpson Desert
locations.analogCategory: Linear Longitudinal Dunes & Hematite Sand Coatings
locations.roversTested: CSIRO / NASA Arid Geomorphology & Orbital Radar Dune Orientation Studies
locations.mineralogy: Iron-oxide-coated quartz sand, clay-pan interdune flats & silcrete
locations.description: Hundreds-of-kilometers-long iron-oxide red sand ridges separated by clay playas, ideal for orbital wind-streak correlation.

locations.name: Lencois Maranhenses
locations.analogCategory: Barchanoid Dune Migration & Interdune Water-Table Interaction
locations.roversTested: Orbital Dune-Field Kinematics & Coastal Aeolian Sedimentology Surveys
locations.mineralogy: Pure quartzose sand sheets with seasonal interdune freshwater lagoons
locations.description: Active barchanoid dune chains used for paleoclimate comparative studies of water-table-controlled interdune deposition.

locations.name: Tenerife Teide Volcanic Terrain
locations.analogCategory: High-Altitude Pyroclastic Mobility & Lunar Polar Simulant Testing
locations.roversTested: ESA ExoMars / LUNA Rover Field Trials & Teide Astrobiology Campaigns
locations.mineralogy: Phonolitic pumice, obsidian, basaltic scoria & iron-rich tephra
locations.description: High-altitude Las Cañadas caldera ash plains and blocky lava lobes utilized by ESA for ExoMars locomotion and Raman instrument validation.

locations.name: Salar de Atacama
locations.roversTested: NASA Astrobiology Institute Salar Expeditions & Raman Biosignature Trials
locations.mineralogy: Halite crusts, gypsum, lithium-rich brines & Andean ignimbrite silts
locations.description: Hyper-arid tectonic salt flat housing photosynthetic endoliths within halite nodules, modeling Martian evaporite biosignature preservation.

locations.name: Chott el Djerid
locations.analogCategory: Playa Lake Evaporite Cycles & Subsurface Radar Attenuation
locations.roversTested: ESA/CNES Mars Express MARSIS & SHARAD Ground-Penetrating Radar Calibration
locations.mineralogy: Halite, gypsum, celestite & saline clay-silt playa deposits
locations.description: Seasonal Saharan salt playa supporting orbital sounding radar calibration and desiccation-polygon mineral mapping.

locations.name: Tassili n'Ajjer
locations.roversTested: Orbital Stereo-Photogrammetry & Saharan Fluvial-Aeolian Analog Studies
locations.mineralogy: Cambro-Ordovician quartzitic sandstone, iron-oxide crusts & wind-carved yardangs
locations.description: Deeply incised Saharan sandstone plateau preserving ancient dendritic river networks later overprinted by hyper-arid wind erosion.

locations.name: Badain Jaran Desert
locations.roversTested: CNSA Planetary Aeolian Research & Megadune GPR Stratigraphy Surveys
locations.mineralogy: Coarse feldspathic-quartz dune sand, carbonate tufa & saline playa muds
locations.description: Stationary 400-meter megadunes fed by deep groundwater, providing stratigraphy benchmarks for large-scale aeolian cross-bedding.

locations.name: Karakum Desert
locations.analogCategory: Takyr Clay Pans & Aeolian Sand-Sheet Dynamics
locations.roversTested: Comparative Planetary Geomorphology & Central Asian Arid Remote Sensing
locations.mineralogy: Takyr desiccated clay crusts, calcareous sand & gypsiferous silt
locations.description: Polygonal takyr clay pans interspersed with sand ridges, illustrating transition zones between fine-grained lacustrine beds and dunes.

locations.name: Pamir Plateau
locations.roversTested: High-Altitude Cryospheric & Solar Radiation Field Instrumentation Trials
locations.mineralogy: Granitic-metamorphic talus, permafrost regolith & glacial rock flour
locations.description: Thin-atmosphere alpine cold desert combining freezing temperatures, high solar irradiance, and fractured frost-heaved regolith.

locations.name: Qaidam Basin
locations.analogCategory: Cold-Arid Yardangs, Polygon Cracks & Magnesium Sulfates
locations.roversTested: CNSA Tianwen-1 / Zhurong Pre-Landing Field Calibration & Mars-Analog Yardang Studies
locations.mineralogy: Magnesium-sulfate evaporites, halite, mudstone yardangs & clay playas
locations.description: High-altitude Tibetan Plateau basin featuring cold-arid yardang fields, polygonal salt ridges, and magnesium-sulfate playas.

locations.name: Mývatn Volcanic Region
locations.roversTested: NASA/USGS Mars Pseudocrater Comparative Studies & Nordic Field Robotics
locations.mineralogy: Scoriaceous basalt, rootless cone tephra & silica-rich geothermal sinters
locations.description: Clustered Skútustaðagígar rootless volcanic cones formed by lava-water interaction, directly mirroring Martian Athabasca Valles cones.

locations.name: Baja California Desert
locations.analogCategory: Granitic Boulder Fields & Arid Alluvial Slope Mobility
locations.roversTested: Regional Marsokhod-Class Suspension & Autonomous Hazard Avoidance Testing
locations.mineralogy: Granodiorite boulder fields, arkosic sand & caliche-cemented alluvial fans
locations.description: Granitic boulder-strewn arid slopes and alluvial aprons providing high-roughness rock-hazard distributions for rocker-bogie rovers.

locations.name: Devon Island Polar Terrain
locations.analogCategory: Polar EVA Spacesuit Ops, Permafrost Drilling & Long-Range Traverses
locations.roversTested: NASA Haughton-Mars Project (HMP), NASA K10 & CSA Lunar-Mars Analog Traverses
locations.mineralogy: Frost-shattered dolomitic limestone, permafrost till & impact-altered regolith
locations.description: Uninhabited High-Arctic polar desert island hosting multi-decade NASA/CSA EVA spacesuit, pressurized rover, and teleoperation campaigns.

locations.name: Valles Caldera Region
locations.analogCategory: Silicic Caldera Ash-Flow Tuffs & Hydrothermal Alteration
locations.roversTested: NASA Apollo Geologic Training & Los Alamos Planetary Volcanology Field Schools
locations.mineralogy: Bandelier rhyolitic ignimbrite tuff, obsidian domes & hydrothermal clays
locations.description: Resurgent volcanic caldera complex with welded ash-flow tuffs and hydrothermal alteration zones studied by Apollo astronauts and Mars geologists.

locations.name: Craters of the Moon Lava Field
locations.roversTested: NASA Apollo 14 Astronaut Geology Training, NASA FINESSE Project, NASA BRAILLE Subsurface Speleology
locations.mineralogy: Vesicular olivine basalt, pahoehoe crusts, spatter cones & intact subterranean lava tubes
locations.description: Extensive Holocene basaltic flood lava field featuring intact subterranean lava tubes, spatter vents, and collapse pits used by Apollo astronauts and modern robotic speleology missions for permanent Moon base shelter analogs.
